audit.policy: fixed 512 proposals per requested family; variants cycle by proposal index; no replacement; construction for every family finishes before the first portfolio fit
audit.independentChallenger: pending external B4 review; this is the builder audit, not an independent challenge or freeze

portfolio.workAccounting: fit: counted assignments, rule/example checks, symbol transitions and law triples; linear algebra precharged a dimension bound; score: actual BFS candidate positions, one unit per cache hit, otherwise declared conservative kernel-work bounds; wall ceiling checked between pair calls
portfolio.selector: highest public training accuracy; ties by registration order; chosen before any sealed scoring
portfolio.grammar: Eq(Fold(T,images,a),Fold(T,images,b)); T ranges over registered cyclic/abelian/group/transformation templates; relations constrain images; first counterexample is added to the active constraints each round
portfolio.memoization: unlabelled (a,b) predictions cached per member across public and sealed sets; cache hits charged one operation
